name: submitMyGrievanceApplication
description: Submits a new grievance on behalf of the signed-in employee. Resolution order is: template, then ground, then summary/description/mood, then optional attachments - the first five are mandatory to actually submit, and channel members for the resolved template are returned in every response from the moment the template is known, even before the rest is given. If no grounds are configured at all, the tool tells the user to contact their HR administrator, since a ground is mandatory. Attachments each need an explicit title and are uploaded individually before Submit - the whole submission is refused if any single upload fails. The tool always previews first and only actually submits when called again with confirmed:true.
